name: slidytabs
summary: DOM-level utility that animates shadcn Tabs with a sliding indicator, plus slider and range-slider tab modes.
description: Adds sliding-indicator animation to shadcn <Tabs /> without wrapping or replacing the component; works with shadcn, shadcn-svelte and shadcn-vue. tabs() slides the indicator between tab positions, slider() makes a draggable single-value slider, and range() a two-handle range slider with a push option.
contains: sliding-indicator animation for shadcn Tabs without changing usage
works with shadcn, shadcn-svelte and shadcn-vue
slider() turns tabs into a draggable slider with a sticky endpoint option
range() gives two draggable endpoints with a push option
controlled via shadcn value/onValueChange props or via index-based props
install and usage docs with live demos
